# JPFA.JK — Japfa Comfeed Indonesia

**PROMOTED 2026-10-31 (WEEKLY_DEEP cold row, triage (d)).** Consumed by **T-INDO-JPFA-001** (PASS_REDUCED 0.50, sized 5.0% NAV at the Judge's multiplier; entry 1,500 limit, target 2,450, kill 1,125; the entry rests 13.8% below the 1,740 close as a waiting price trigger).

**Screen row at promotion:** INDO NEGLECTED #8, IDR 1,740, −37.16% off the 52-week high, mom12 −0.07%, mom6 −30.0%, mom1 −14.71%, vol 42.8%, ADV IDR 24.54bn, coverage thin.

**Why it was picked:** the largest drawdown in the NEGLECTED sleeve on a name whose FY2025 record earnings (EPS 344, ROE 21.5%) had de-rated to ~5x; the Saturday question was whether that is peak-cycle earnings (the VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL incentive-price trap) or a normalised-value entry. The deep-dive concluded FY2025/H1-26 is peak-cycle: normalised EPS ~300 (7.0% EBIT margin, the 4-year mean), base value IDR 2,450–2,700, so the entry was re-set to the bear value 1,500 rather than spot.

**Regime vs macro desk:** neutral-to-WITH. The INDO rate-sensitive AVOID applies to consumer *discretionary*; poultry/feed is a domestic staples protein chain, and the agri deck carries no directional tilt. Feed costs (corn/soymeal) are the transmission channel: the deck's FY2027E path is ~15–22% above spot, a cost headwind the thesis prices in its normalised margin.

**Re-advance gate:** a new thesis naming T-INDO-JPFA-001 is required if the entry is not filled before 2027-03-31, or on a material change in the through-cycle margin / DPS / related-party disclosure. Do not cold-re-underwrite on price alone.
